code.originalText: Sixteen-week review after twelve therapy sessions: symptoms, drinking, safety and his plan

text.paragraph: Sixteen-week review after twelve sessions of therapy. [S]

Geronimo returns sixteen weeks after intake, with the interpreter. He finished the twelfth session of cognitive processing therapy last week. Nightmares now come about once every two weeks, and he sleeps six hours most nights. He had one evening of heavy drinking three weeks ago, which he raised himself; since then he has had a single drink on a few evenings. He takes sertraline 50 mg, naltrexone and thiamine without side effects and has not fallen. His stool test was negative and the hepatitis C and B tests show no infection and no immunity to hepatitis B. He says he prays in his own way and that this is part of how he is doing; he did not describe it and was not asked. He wants his zoster and Tdap vaccines today. [S]
